warm_rate_definition: admitted slices in shots after the setup and compilation-bearing first shot of each shard, divided by their summed per-slice wall time

conditioned_by_time_in_shot.coordinate: seconds since the shot's first written slice

deciles.definition: decile of each shot's own written-slice time span, pooled across shots

conditioned_by_topology_class.reason: the session frames carry no decodable topology-class field and the manifest slice records carry no requested_class, so the split cannot be structured by topology class under this layout

pin_displacement_mm.definition: 1000 * (conditioned_centroid_error_m - free_centroid_error_m) over written slices with both finite
